faq.q: Can I bring my own clubs?
faq.a: Yes. You can use your own clubs or our rental clubs. Club rental is $25.

It takes 1 hour for the average golfer to play 18 holes. As a rule of thumb if you have 4 players it will take 4 hours to play 18 holes. Because all golfers play at a different pace, we can't guarantee you will complete all 18 holes during your reservation.
